preconditions.description: The number of integers q is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= a_i <= 2**25 - 1 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each integer a_i is between 2 and 2^25 - 1.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of input integers.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(output[i], int) for i in range(len(output)))
postconditions.description: Each output line is an integer.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] == max(gcd(a[i] ^ b, a[i] & b) for b in range(1, a[i])) for i in range(len(output)))
postconditions.description: Each output integer is the maximum GCD of (a[i] ^ b, a[i] & b) for 1 <= b < a[i].
